summary: Preserved candidate a6d1911d's valid API, identity, native alignment, and Kimi K3 image fixes. Independently reproduced that repeated Qwen video and Whisper audio caller IDs still cross the media-load boundary twice. Only Kimi K3 calls prepare_media_artifacts, so general image coverage is also absent. No evidence-backed general processor correction was possible without compatible multimodal architectures and weights.

tests.what_was_measured: Against the candidate implementation, two requests with the same video cache ID reached Qwen load_mm_data twice and two requests with the same audio cache ID reached Whisper load_audio twice.
Candidate compatibility and focused regressions: 94 passed and 27 subtests passed.
Python source compilation after consolidating the candidate onto the prepared base.

gpu_execution.evidence: No compatible multimodal model weights were available. The tiny Llama fixture cannot validate multimodal preprocessing or Responses historical-media reuse, so it was not used as substitute evidence.

remaining_limitations: Video caller IDs are parsed and aligned but representative Qwen video processing still loads the media on every request.
Audio caller IDs are parsed and aligned but representative Whisper audio processing still loads the media on every request.
Only Kimi K3 invokes prepare_media_artifacts; caller-ID artifact caching is not general across image processors.
Responses previous_response_id has no real multimodal serving proof that historical media skips read/download, decode, preprocessing, and feature hashing.
General support requires model-specific artifact and recomposition adapters plus compatible-model validation; adding those without architectures and weights would be speculative.
No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
